description: Pins the music-event log schema. Each entry holds a tic number and a discriminator-tagged event (change-music, pause-music, resume-music, stop-music). Music is event-driven and synthesized differently depending on the music device, so this log captures discrete state transitions rather than periodic PCM hashes (SFX uses the 02-013 audio-window format).
scopeNote: Music events only; SFX PCM mix is captured by 02-013.
